scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n v1,v2,v3 -c blue,magenta,yellow "bun run --cwd apps/v1 dev" "bun run --cwd apps/v2 dev" "bun run --cwd apps/v3 dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/v1 build && bun run --cwd apps/v2 build && bun run --cwd apps/v3 build
scripts.type-check: bun run --cwd apps/v1 type-check && bun run --cwd apps/v2 type-check && bun run --cwd apps/v3 type-check
